title: The Lemongrab Diet
synopsis: Lemongrab decides his kingdom is unacceptably sour and orders everyone to become sweet, with predictable results.
plot:
After tasting a single Candy Kingdom cupcake at a diplomatic function, Lemongrab returns home shaken. His subjects are sour. He is sour. It is unacceptable. He decrees that Castle Lemongrab will become sweet by the end of the week and sends the Lemon Children to steal sugar from the Candy Kingdom. Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to sort it out before it becomes a war.

At Castle Lemongrab, the Lemon Children have coated everything in frosting and are miserable. Lemongrab himself is eating spoonfuls of sugar and screaming that it isn't working. Finn tries to explain that being sour is fine, and Lemongrab has him put in the Reconditioning Chamber, which is now full of sprinkles and mostly pleasant.

Jake, who likes lemons, sits with Lemongrab and makes lemonade: sour and sweet together. Lemongrab tastes it and goes very quiet. He issues a new decree: sour is acceptable, in combination. The frosting is scraped off, the Lemon Children are released, and Lemongrab sends Bubblegum a single pitcher of lemonade with a note that says 'ACCEPTABLE'. She keeps the note.
transcriptText:
Princess Bubblegum: Lemongrab, try the cupcake. It's a diplomatic cupcake.
Lemongrab: [eating it] ...What is this.
Princess Bubblegum: Sweet?
Lemongrab: [whispering] Sweet. [screaming] SWEEEEET!
[Castle Lemongrab.]
Lemongrab: Attention, lemon citizens! We are SOUR! This is UNACCEPTABLE! By week's end we shall be SWEET!
Lemon Children: [in unison] Yes, Father.
Lemongrab: Go. Steal the sugar. All of the sugar.
[The Candy Kingdom. A Banana Guard runs past carrying an empty sugar bag.]
Princess Bubblegum: Finn. Jake. Lemongrab situation.
Jake: Say no more.
Finn: You could say a little more.
[Castle Lemongrab, now coated in frosting.]
Finn: Dude, what did you do?
Lemongrab: [eating sugar from a spoon] It's not WORKING! I eat the sugar and I am still SOUR!
Finn: Lemongrab, being sour is fine. That's just... who you are.
Lemongrab: RECONDITIONING CHAMBER. ONE HOUR.
Finn: [being carried away] It's full of sprinkles! It's actually kind of nice in here!
Jake: Hey. Lemongrab. Sit down a sec.
Lemongrab: I do not sit. I loom.
Jake: Loom, then. You got lemons?
Lemongrab: I have ONLY lemons.
Jake: Okay. Sugar. Water. Lemons. [squeezing] Here. Drink.
Lemongrab: [sipping] ...
Jake: Well?
Lemongrab: [very quietly] It is sour. And it is sweet. At the same time.
Jake: That's lemonade, buddy.
Lemongrab: [standing] NEW DECREE. Sour is ACCEPTABLE. In combination. Scrape the frosting. Release the boy.
Finn: [emerging, covered in sprinkles] What'd I miss?
[Candy Kingdom. A pitcher of lemonade arrives with a note.]
Princess Bubblegum: [reading] 'Acceptable.' [pinning it to the wall] He's growing.
